title: Tier 3 weekly scale workflow
summary: .github/workflows/benchmark-scale.yml against the live Db2 via protected environment secrets, with a concurrency guard so it never overlaps EPIC-12's live-Db2 stories.
description:
Write `.github/workflows/benchmark-scale.yml`, scheduled (`0 4 * * 0`) and `workflow_dispatch`-able, connecting to the live Db2 instance via repo secrets exposed only through protected environment rules — never to PR-triggered workflows from forks. Use `concurrency: group: live-db2, cancel-in-progress: false` so two runs can never hit the shared instance simultaneously, and operate only under a reserved `tenant_id` prefix so this workflow's data never collides with other tiers' data.

**This same `live-db2` concurrency group must also cover EPIC-12's BRUN-3 and BRUN-4** (both require a live Db2 instance) — if those stories haven't landed a shared lock yet, this workflow's group name and any manual-run runbook should be the one both sides adopt, so a human running BRUN-3/BRUN-4 by hand doesn't collide with this scheduled job. Acceptance: two concurrent runs cannot overlap, verified by triggering one manually while a scheduled one is in flight; secrets are confirmed inaccessible to fork-triggered workflows; results are committed to BENCHMARKS.md by the workflow itself; a documented manual-abort-and-cleanup path exists for a run that hangs against the shared instance. Depends on BM-21 and BM-4.
